notes.title: Demo version 0.2.5 update
notes.notes:
Added the ability to switch between fullscreen, borderless and windowed modes

Fixed the behavior of dropdown lists (the arrow was not clickable)

Fixed several typos and translation errors

notes.title: Demoversion update 0.2.4
notes.notes:
fixed translation of several phrases in the dialogue with the manager on day 8

when the message "user typing" appears, the dialogue now scrolls down stably

fixed several more typos in the texts

added 2 articles to the in-game manual and corrected several descriptions

notes.title: Version 0.2.3: UI fixes, typo fixes
notes.notes:
- Fixed typos in the manual and stories
- Fixed display of the manual in low resolutions (the text overlapped the scroll on the right, the text itself took up less space than the list of elements)
- Fixed the behavior of the mouse cursor, which sometimes changed to a standard arrow when moving along the buttons

notes.title: Updating the demo version to 0.2.1
notes.notes: Fixed minor typos in dialogs. Thanks to everyone who writes about them to my email, in the community, in the group and other places!
